title: Pie stuff
description: mcreator datapack that adds pie stuff like a dimension and smelting pie for xp and an end rod (very random)
body:
Made an mcreator mod that adds a pie biome pie dimension (that you have to use [/execute in _____________ run tp @s ~ ~ ~] to get to) a smelting recipe to turn pie into endrods and xp and other pie-related stuff
credit goes to mcreator and mojang because they make, the stuff.
thank you for downloading and enjoy
